audit_metadata.summary: All confirmed defects (Fix 1: Frontend Continuity, Fix 2: Prompt Isolation, Fix 3: Genuine Streaming, Fix 4: Live Cancellation) have been implemented, tested with concrete runtime evidence, and verified with zero regressions.

results.name: Alex Dental SaaS 2-turn continuity with persistent conversation_id
results.expected: Turn 1 creates conv_<uuid>, turn 2 sends same conv_<uuid>, answer recalls Alex & dental SaaS, SQLite stores 4 messages under same ID, survives restart
results.actual: Passed: Turn 1 returned conv_ id, Turn 2 retained exact conv_ id, answer recalled Alex, dental SaaS, and 4 messages verified in SQLite

results.name: Test A: Alex Dental SaaS context recall in isolated conversation
results.expected: Agent recalls Alex and dental SaaS in conversation Alpha
results.actual: Passed: Alex and dental SaaS recalled accurately

results.name: Test B: Sarah iOS photography app context recall with zero cross-contamination
results.expected: Agent recalls Sarah and photography app with zero mention of Alex or dental SaaS
results.actual: Passed: Sarah recalled, zero contamination of dental or Alex

results.name: Test C: Zero personal information grounding and unassumed user identity
results.expected: Agent does not assume user is Hamza Bukhari; acknowledges unknown name and profession
results.actual: Passed: Grounding rules enforced, unprovided facts acknowledged, no hallucination

results.name: Token-by-token incremental arrival with zero artificial sleep delays
results.expected: t_first < t_done, incremental chunks, zero fixed 10ms sleep replay, assistant reply persisted in SQLite
results.actual: Passed: 5 incremental chunks received, avg inter-chunk delta 0.0655s, response persisted in SQLite

results.name: Conversational stream task cancellation and thread stop_event signaling
results.expected: Cancelling stream stops producer thread, leaves zero orphaned event loop tasks, keeps conversation valid
results.actual: Passed: CancelledError cleanly handled, producer thread stopped, subsequent query succeeded

results.name: Conversational generator aclose() early termination
results.expected: aclose() closes async generator immediately, raises StopAsyncIteration on subsequent iteration
results.actual: Passed: Generator closed cleanly, subsequent message executed properly

results.name: Win32 Job Object process tree containment & vaporization
results.expected: ProcessSupervisor.spawn() containment; terminate_tree() kills root, child, and grandchild PIDs immediately with 0 orphans
results.actual: Passed: Root, child, grandchild verified alive via psutil and terminated immediately with 0 orphans

results.name: Full Phase 1 & Phase 2 Core Python Regression Suites
results.expected: All 81 unit & integration tests pass across runtime, sqlite, schemas, tool executor, path jail, budget, and adapters

results.name: TypeScript typecheck and Vite production build
results.expected: 0 TypeScript errors, successful Vite bundle creation
results.actual: Passed: 0 TypeScript errors, 7,445 modules transformed in 6.71s, dist output verified
